correctness.rationale: For all a,b,c,d>=1, n=2^a3^b5^c7^d, least B generating all units from coprime integers t<=B is controlled by CRT and finite-abelian Frattini quotients. Reduction to exponents min(a,3),min(b,2),min(c,2),min(d,2) kills only local Frattini subgroups, hence the all-exponent family reduces to finite elementary character coordinates modulo 4,8,9,25,49. Primitive roots 2 (9,25) and 3 (49) yield exact discrete-log rows for 11,13,17,19,23. Three 2-character rank matrices for a=1,2,>=3 have determinants 1,-1,-3 (odd); the 3-character 2x2 minor has determinant -2 modulo3, and the 5/7 coordinates of 11 are nonzero. Thus B<=19 for a<=2, B<=23 for a>=3. Conversely 2-rank dimensions 3,4,5 force bounds; at a=1 the first 3 rows are dependent, so <=17 fails. Independently computed all 24 reduced exponent rank cases and exact subgroups at cutoff and immediately below on n=210,420,840,22050,44100,88200. These finite checks support local certificates, while Frattini reduction proves the unbounded-exponent quantifier.
residual_risks: Requires the standard cyclic structure of odd prime-power unit groups and the noncyclic 2-power unit-group decomposition, both explicitly invoked.
